title: Plugin Integrations
meta: Connect payments, analytics, email tools or your own backend to your WooCommerce plugin, tested with real orders. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce plugin integrations with the tools you use
overview: We link your plugin to outside tools such as Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, a shipping carrier, an accounting package or your own server. Each connection stores keys safely in settings, uses background jobs so checkout stays fast, retries when a service is down and logs what was sent. We test with sandbox accounts and test orders on a staging copy before handover.

pkgs.blurb: Up to three tools, using background jobs and a log screen.
A full set of connections with field mapping and a past-order sync.

faq: Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, ShipStation, QuickBooks, Slack and any tool with a public API are common. Send the API documentation of yours and we confirm the fit first.
Do the connected services cost extra?
Possibly. Each tool bills you directly, and some charge for API access. Our price covers building and testing the connection only, and we flag any paid tiers before we start.
Will the connection slow down checkout?
No. Calls run in the background through Action Scheduler after the order is placed, so the customer never waits for an outside service. Failures are retried and logged.
Can you connect to my own server?
Yes. We build against your API, or add a small endpoint if you do not have one. We agree the fields and the direction of the sync in writing before building.
